briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Stripe
**Meeting:** 17 November 2026
**Window:** Last 30 days (approx. 18 Oct to 17 Nov 2026)
**Sources:** Search results provided only. Coverage ends 13 Nov 2026.

## Summary
Stripe's most concrete recent change is in stablecoin payouts, where Global Payouts now reaches crypto wallets in 160+ markets. Stripe also appears in an Anthropic customer list and in a scheduled Celo/MiniPay onramp. I found no hires and no deals announced within the window.

## What changed (last 30 days)

**Launches**
- Stripe lets US businesses send stablecoin payments directly to crypto wallets in more than 160 markets. The wallet capability is part of Global Payouts and launched in public preview in early November 2026. (https://cryptonews.net/news/market/33703716)
- Link by Stripe is scheduled to integrate with MiniPay on 12 Nov 2026, giving EU and US users one-click stablecoin purchases. MiniPay has more than 20 million wallets. I could not confirm the integration went live. (https://www.tradingview.com/news/coinmarketcal:ce753058b094b:0-celo-minipay-integrates-link-by-stripe-for-one-click-stablecoin-purchases-12-nov-2026)

**Partnerships and customers**
- Stripe is named among customers, with Bridgewater and Salesforce, for Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, now in private beta with Anthropic (10 Nov 2026). (https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-2)

**Hires**
- No hires found in the sources.

**Deals**
- No deals announced within the window found in the sources.
- Earlier M&A listed in a company profile, all outside the window: OpenRouter, Inc. (1 Aug 2026, 7.50B USD); Clerky, Inc. (1 Aug 2026); Valora, Inc. (1 Dec 2025). (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/igPwhNOUwEGy)

**Market context**
- WSJ reports that Meta's personal AI assistants have recently been enabled to make purchases on cardholders' behalf, and that banks are racing to respond. The snippet does not mention Stripe. (https://www.wsj.com/finance/ai-bots-are-using-credit-cards-banks-are-racing-to-keep-up-c30dda30)

**Background**
- Stripe is a private, B2B payments company headquartered in South San Francisco, founded 2010. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/igPwhNOUwEGy)

## Gaps
- Results contain nothing on Stripe's financials, leadership changes, or pricing.
- Results end 13 Nov, so events from 14 to 17 Nov are not covered.

## Open questions
1. What is the timeline from public preview to general availability for stablecoin payouts, and what compliance controls apply across the 160+ markets?
2. How is the Link by Stripe and MiniPay onramp performing in its first weeks, and what role does Stripe expect stablecoin rails to play in its payments volume?
3. What is Stripe's role in Anthropic's Enterprise Frontier Safeguards beta, and how is Stripe approaching AI agents that make purchases on users' behalf?
